pages.title: About
pages.content:
## SDSC Hackathon: Generative AI

Two days at **ETH Zurich, Andreasturm** (Zurich Oerlikon), 30 November – 1 December 2023.

Professionals from academia, the private sector and public organizations came together to explore generative AI tools and technologies, building proof-of-concepts against real-world challenges.

### Goals

- **Develop** simple PoCs using Generative AI technologies
- **Apply** them to real-world challenges in the private, public and academic sectors
- **Share** code, knowledge, best practices and use-case ideas
- **Connect** with other data science professionals

Participation was free; registration was mandatory.
